expectations.buyer: Banks, payment service providers, fraud teams, and scheme participants implementing Verification of Payee and instant payments
expectations.pain: Name matching, diacritics, identifiers, latency, exception codes, and cross-provider behavior can diverge across implementations
expectations.strongestIncumbent: European Payments Council specifications and test artefacts, national schemes, payment processors, bank certification labs, and conformance vendors
expectations.biggestRisk: Scheme-owned test environments and certification may absorb the simulator; non-euro scope may be too fragmented and inaccessible
